title: Sukha Singh Funds the Khalsa Through Daring Lahore Raids

blocks.text: Inside Lahore, Sukha Singh proves both audacity and speed by seizing wealth in the city and escaping before the alarm can trap him. The exploit is narrated as tactical intelligence rather than random theft, because his true loyalty lies with the Khalsa rather than with personal gain.

Back among the Singhs he settles what he owes for his horse and contributed the entire booty to the community kitchen. The gesture is central to the page, showing that courage without service would be incomplete and that the raid feeds the Panth before it elevates the raider.
The closing lines sharpen his martial profile. Sukha Singh is remembered as a fighter skilled across many weapons, but that prowess is nested inside humility, discipline, and communal giving.
